title: Finn's Lost Isle Quest
moral: Teamwork and courage help overcome any challenge.

story: Captain Finn finds a treasure map and gathers a crew to search for the Isle of the Lost. They face a dangerous storm but survive through teamwork. On the island, they encounter jungle dangers and traps before reaching a treasure cave. Through courage and unity, they succeed in their quest, realizing teamwork is their greatest strength.
